title: Decentralised Update Selection with Semi-Strategic Experts
reasoning: The paper focuses on game theory and mechanism design to incentivize 'honest' voting and analyze strategic behavior in a decentralized update selection process. While 'semi-strategic' experts imply agents who might deviate for personal gain but are not malicious, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark moral, ethical, or religious systems. Its scope is within economic theory and algorithmic mechanism design.
